reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: Extremely hydrating but runs out really fast, good to buy if wanting to try out cream before committing to full size product.
reviews.zh: 保濕效果一流，但用得好快。如果想試吓枝 cream 先再決定買唔買大裝，呢個係好選擇。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: This serum is amazing! It hydrates my skin really well, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft and glowing. I would definitely buy it again.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華超讚！保濕效果一流，吸收得快，用完之後皮膚軟熟又光澤。一定會再買。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: 無難な水分感あるセラムとクリームを探していて、アヌアのセラムはいつも人気だったので試しにクリームもついてるセットを買いました。ずっと顔に残るわけではありませんが匂いが苦手です。塗ったあとは水分感あるツヤが残ることを期待していましたがけっこうマットよりになったので残念でした。ベタベタ感が苦手な方や夏にはいいと思います。
reviews.zh: 一直想搵一啲溫和、又有水分感嘅精華同 cream，見 Anua 嘅精華一直都好受歡迎，所以買咗附帶 cream 嘅套裝試吓。雖然唔係成日黐喺塊面度，但我接受唔到個味道。本來期望塗完之後留低有水分感嘅光澤感，但結果偏向霧面，有啲失望。怕黐笠嘅人或者夏天用就啱。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: This Anua PDRN hyaluronic serum intensely hydrates and repairs sensitive skin. Its lightweight texture absorbs fast, easing redness and locking in long-lasting moisture for smooth, glowing complexions.
reviews.zh: 呢支 Anua PDRN 透明質酸精華可以強效保濕、修復敏感肌。質地輕盈，吸收得快，可以紓緩泛紅，鎖住長效水分，令肌膚平滑有光澤。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: I really liked both the serum - and the big surprise for me which is the cream. The serum is very light and watery and I can layer it under everything, and the cream is super nice and light as well, and I think my face has nave been that plump.
reviews.zh: 兩支我都好鍾意，精華同 cream 兩支都好用——而 cream 對我嚟講係大驚喜。精華質地好輕、好水感，可以疊加喺任何護膚品下面；cream 都係超讚好輕盈，我覺得塊面從來未試過咁飽滿。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text: I like the serum , it’s moisturizing and hydrating but nothing extraordinary I would say also I haven’t seen any magical difference between my skin I have been using for almost 2 weeks now
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢支精華，佢保濕、滋潤，但講真唔算特別突出。用咗差唔多兩個禮拜，我未見到皮膚有咩神奇變化。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text:
My skin is normal to dry and I dont usually suffer with acne unless on my monthly. The weather is also snowy winter rn so my face feels like I dry dessert landscape, and I work in a paint shop with super dry air so I need extra hydration where I can get it. My face feels softer, hydrated and looks brighter. 

Its consistency is thick and it absorbs well, but my skin drinks up anything it can get. It feels soft on application and I look shiny in a good way, like Edward in twilight.
reviews.zh:
我嘅膚質係中性偏乾，除咗每月嗰幾日，一般都唔會爆瘡。而家又係落雪嘅冬天，塊面乾到好似沙漠咁，加上我做緊油漆工，空氣極度乾燥，所以用到嘅保濕都盡量攞。塊面感覺柔軟咗、保濕咗，望落都光亮咗。

質地厚但吸收得好，塊面好似乜都吸收晒咁。搽完之後好柔順，望落有種好嘅光澤，好似 Twilight 入面嘅 Edward 咁。

reviews.shade: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 30ml Set (+Cream 30ml)
reviews.text:
Love the way it feels on the skin and how it hydrates. I use it before the s.nature cream and I just love the combo.

However, the pdrn is so low it is really more a Hydrating serum rather pdrn serum
reviews.zh:
好鍾意佢搽上皮膚嘅感覺同保濕效果。我會喺 s.nature cream 之前用，配搭一流。

不過 PDRN 含量好低，講真佢比較似保濕精華多過 PDRN 精華。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
